result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, mainly related to horizontal cropping of cards and a promotional banner with low contrast text.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section cuts off the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) at the edge of the screen, showing only partial content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indicators are visible or add peek/fade effect to signal scrollability, and confirm card is fully scrollable.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and subtext) has low contrast against the light green background, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color contrast (e.g., darker green or white with shadow) for better readability.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, hiding additional categories without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or arrow indicator to show more categories are scrollable.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is cropped off before showing the restaurant name and details, unlike other listed restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent card height and complete information is visible without abrupt cropping at the screen edge.
